nodes.label: Decision
nodes.text: Do not reuse OPTIMIZABLE_ENTRY_RE in this transform hook; leave the regex as before or hoist it under a different variable name.

nodes.label: Comment
nodes.text:
I don't think this is quite right. This transform hook happens to filter the same js files regex, but it's not filtering for optimizable entries and isn't doing optimization here.

We should leave the regex as before or hoist as a variable with a different name.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.text: Retain the specific name OPTIMIZABLE_ENTRY_RE rather than renaming it to a generic name.

nodes.label: Comment
nodes.text: I think we should keep the specific name here so we keep its semantic meaning of the files we support to optimize.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.text: The devtools option is frozen at config hook time, so any changes to it later are no-ops.

nodes.label: Comment
nodes.text:
Sorry I didn't notice that the `devtools` value is frozen at this point. This means any changes to `devtools` option in the config hook will be no-op, not only the enable/disable change.

This description isn't clear about this. I think we should make it clear.
https://github.com/webfansplz/vite/blob/18fa5344891cae946cdf4f9c03be3db510b0989b/docs/config/shared-options.md?plain=1#L630
We probably should emit a warning if it's tried to be changed. Although that requires the knowledge of the `DevToolsConfig` type, which Vite cannot rely on (as devtools may add properties).
